rules.description: Death must be registered or reported to a coroner with a certificate
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only use Tell Us Once after the death has been registered or reported to a coroner with a certificate

rules.description: Deceased must have been living in England, Scotland or Wales
rules.reason_if_failed: Tell Us Once cannot be used if the person was living in Northern Ireland or permanently abroad when they died

rules.description: Reference number must be used within 28 days of issue
rules.reason_if_failed: Your reference number has expired. Contact the registrar to get a new reference number

rules.description: User must have a Tell Us Once reference number from registrar
rules.reason_if_failed: You need a reference number from the registrar to use Tell Us Once. Contact your local register office

rules.description: Must have permission from executor/administrator or next of kin to share their details
rules.reason_if_failed: You need permission from the executor, administrator, surviving spouse or next of kin before giving their details

edge_cases.description: Person died abroad temporarily (e.g., on holiday or business trip)
edge_cases.action: Can use Tell Us Once if death certificate is verified by foreign embassy/high commission. Registrar will advise on verification process.

edge_cases.description: Coroner holding an inquest, death not yet registered
edge_cases.action: Can use Tell Us Once with interim death certificate from coroner. Contact registrar for reference number after obtaining interim certificate.

edge_cases.description: Person was living in Northern Ireland when they died
edge_cases.action: Cannot use Tell Us Once. Must notify organisations directly. Hand off to manual process guidance.

edge_cases.description: Person was permanently living abroad when they died
edge_cases.action: Cannot use Tell Us Once. Must notify UK organisations directly if applicable. Hand off to manual process guidance.

edge_cases.description: Reporter needs additional support (e.g., BSL, Relay UK, language assistance)
edge_cases.action: Registrar can complete Tell Us Once with the reporter or provide BSL video relay service/Relay UK details. Welsh language support available.
